lead.title: Brussels launches the first Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA) of medical devices: Highlife and Edwards SAPIEN M3, two mitral valves
lead.deck: Through implementing decision C(2026) 7113 of October 2, the European Commission selects two devices for joint clinical assessment under the HTA Regulation for the first time: Edwards' SAPIEN M3 (assessed by the Dutch ZIN with Norway's DMP) and the HIGHLIFE system from Paris-based Highlife (assessed by France's HAS with Poland's AOTMiT). Manufacturers have 100 days after the Commission's request to file their dossier: clinical evidence becomes the bottleneck to European market access.

milestone.title: GE HealthCare wins CE mark for its MINItrace Magni cyclotron for in-house radioisotope production
milestone.summary: The automated, self-shielded cyclotron produces carbon-11, fluorine-18, nitrogen-13 and oxygen-15 and automates beam tuning, target irradiation and target preparation. GE also extends its PETtrace solid-target platform to copper-64, after gallium-68 (2022) and zirconium-89 (early 2026).
milestone.why: Making PET tracers on site brings European hospitals and radiopharmacies closer to theranostics (copper-64 is being studied as a companion diagnostic to copper-67 in prostate and HER2+ breast cancer), where imaging and drugs converge.

brefsEurope.title: MDR/IVDR revision: European Parliament vote expected in Q1 2027, adoption targeted for summer 2027
brefsEurope.summary: After IMCO and BUDG committees voted in favor in September, competent authorities discussed the text in Dublin; trilogues follow, with a compromise hoped for by summer 2027. Current MDR/IVDR rules remain fully applicable until then, and the loosening of Article 5.5 (in-house manufacturing by hospitals) worries industry.

brefsIntl.title: Edwards recalls four lots of SAPIEN M3 Commander M delivery systems after a death
brefsIntl.summary: FDA early alert: three balloon bursts during inflation, one death and one serious injury as of October 5; fewer than 200 units affected. SAPIEN M3 is one of the two devices selected for the first European JCA.

brefsIntl.title: Medtronic completes its MiniMed exit through an exchange offer oversubscribed 5.4x
brefsIntl.summary: Medtronic exchanges all its remaining MiniMed shares (Nasdaq-listed since March 2026, $17.50 at the October 15 close) for its own stock and holds none. MiniMed plans to exit most of its ~160 services agreements with Medtronic in 2027.

brefsIntl.title: NEJM: continuous glucose monitoring cuts HbA1c from 8.8% to 7.2% in type 2 diabetics not on insulin
brefsIntl.summary: Dexcom-funded randomized trial (Dexcom G7, 26 weeks, 22 US primary care practices): 7.2% vs 8.0% with routine care. CMS has yet to decide whether to extend Medicare coverage to these patients, a market of about 25 million US adults.

word.full: Joint Clinical Assessment (EU-level joint clinical assessment)
word.definition: A single assessment of a device’s clinical effectiveness run by several European countries at once under the HTA Regulation, which each state then reuses to decide on reimbursement.

parts.label: Selection
parts.role: the Commission picks high-stakes devices after an expert-panel opinion

parts.label: Dossier
parts.role: the manufacturer files clinical evidence on the EU HTA platform

parts.label: JCA report
parts.role: two national agencies write the joint analysis

how.t: Once MDR certification is complete, the Commission selects the device by implementing decision, on the HTA Coordination Group’s recommendation.
The Commission sets the scope (population, comparators, outcomes); the manufacturer has 100 days to file its dossier.
An assessor and co-assessor draft the JCA report, which the manufacturer reviews for factual accuracy before member states reuse it.

word.why: JCA makes comparative clinical evidence a prerequisite for European market access: for a VC, it makes development plans for innovative devices costlier and longer, and favors companies that design trials around HTA comparators from the start.

startups.name: Highlife
startups.use: HIGHLIFE trans-septal mitral valve replacement system (valve-in-ring), CE marked in January 2026; one of the first two devices selected for a JCA, assessed by HAS with AOTMiT

startups.name: Scarlet
startups.use: London platform certifying medical software and AI, designated a Third-Party Review Organization; $50M Series B led by Headline to speed regulatory compliance

startups.name: Sava
startups.use: Subcutaneous continuous glucose microsensor: Series B led by Ascensia, which gets exclusive European distribution; CE mark and launch targeted within 18 to 24 months
